title: AGEX Grounded Citation Check Contract
description: TODO(spec-gap): provisional contract -- no LEVEL 3 domain specification for the Knowledge Engine exists yet (see docs/INDEX.md). This formalizes the smallest checkable piece of MASTER.md principles #7 (Model Output은 권한이 아니다) and #14 (Schema Validation on all AI Actions) available before real Model Gateway generation is wired up: an AI-generated answer may only cite Knowledge Engine document_ids that were actually retrieved as candidates for its query. A citation to any other document_id is rejected as a fabricated (hallucinated) reference -- see src/context/knowledge.engine.ts verifyGroundedCitations().

grounded.description: True if at least one citation was provided. False is not necessarily wrong -- some valid answers need no citation -- it is a signal for downstream consumers (UI badges, future autonomy gating) to treat the answer as unverified.

candidates_considered.description: Number of KnowledgeCandidate results available to cite for this query, after ACL filtering.

cited_document_ids.description: document_id values the answer actually cited. Every value here is guaranteed to be a subset of the retrieved candidate set -- citing anything else raises UNGROUNDED_CITATION (category VALIDATION) before this object is constructed.
